name: poly_int_odd_at_zero_one_no_root
statement: (p : Polynomial ℤ) (h0 : Odd (Polynomial.eval 0 p)) (h1 : Odd (Polynomial.eval 1 p)) (n : ℤ) : Polynomial.eval n p ≠ 0
closed: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℤ) (h0 : Odd (Polynomial.eval 0 p)) (h1 : Odd (Polynomial.eval 1 p)) (n : ℤ), Polynomial.eval n p ≠ 0
informal: An integer polynomial with p(0) and p(1) odd has no integer root — n - 0 ∣ p(n) - p(0) and n - 1 ∣ p(n) - p(1) (Polynomial.sub_dvd_eval_sub); if p(n) = 0 then both n and n-1 divide odd numbers, but one of them is even.
type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℤ), Odd (Polynomial.eval 0 p) → Odd (Polynomial.eval 1 p) → ∀ (n : ℤ), Polynomial.eval n p ≠ 0
